allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

dimensions.description: Machine-computed coverage dimensions derived from pairwise traceability checks. Each dimension records how many upstream IDs are covered by a downstream link type, with a ratio and the list of uncovered IDs. Run `specdev completeness-check spec --repo-root ./devspec_toolkit --json` to obtain these values; do not estimate or guess them. A ratio < 0.8 triggers W592 (promotable to E592). All four dimensions must be present.

fr_api_coverage.description: Fraction of functional requirements that have at least one API endpoint bound to them. uncovered_ids lists fr-* IDs with no api binding. Example: 8 of 10 FRs have an API → covered_count=8, total_count=10, ratio=0.8.

fr_fixture_coverage.description: Fraction of functional requirements that have at least one test fixture targeting them. uncovered_ids lists fr-* IDs with no fixture target. A ratio < 1.0 means some requirements have no automated test coverage.

fr_milestone_coverage.description: Fraction of functional requirements that are referenced in at least one implementation plan milestone deliverable. uncovered_ids lists fr-* IDs absent from all milestone deliverable sets.

capability_fr_coverage.description: Fraction of capabilities (from Step 01) that have at least one functional requirement implementing them. uncovered_ids lists capability-* IDs with no FR back-link. Canonical kind referenced: completeness_dimension. Example canonical ref: {"id": "cn:core:completeness_dimension:coverage-completeness", "kind": "completeness_dimension"}.

milestone_decomp_completeness.description: Optional 5th dimension. Fraction of milestones (from Step 14) whose fr_refs are fully decomposed into tasks. uncovered_ids lists milestone IDs where not all fr_refs have a corresponding task entry. Signals W567 INCOMPLETE_MILESTONE_DECOMPOSITION — milestones without full task coverage of their fr_refs. Populated by the CLI completeness-check command; do not estimate.

allOf.description: Step-specific properties for 13a_completeness_assessment. The dimensions object holds machine-computed coverage ratios for all four coverage dimensions.

coverageDimension.description: A single coverage dimension with counts, ratio, and uncovered IDs. All values must be derived from actual spec content — not estimated.

covered_count.description: Number of upstream IDs that have at least one downstream link in this dimension.

total_count.description: Total number of upstream IDs in this dimension's scope.

ratio.description: Coverage ratio: covered_count / total_count. Must equal covered_count / total_count when total_count > 0; must be 1.0 when total_count = 0 (vacuous coverage). Anti-pattern: estimating the ratio without counting actual IDs.

uncovered_ids.description: IDs from the upstream scope that have no downstream link. Must contain exactly total_count - covered_count entries. Each ID must be a real ID from the upstream spec — not invented.
